_comment: Mutation testing: break the code on purpose, check whether a test notices. A SURVIVED mutant is a line nothing is watching — the test that claimed to cover it cannot fail. This is the automated form of the manual check that found ~10 live bugs hiding behind green suites on 2026-08-04/05. See AGENTS.md 'Test discipline'.
_mutate_comment: ONLY modules whose behaviour is pinned by DB-FREE tests (vitest.mutation.config.ts). A module tested solely through the live-DB suites would report false survivors here and teach everyone to ignore the report. Grow this list when a module gains DB-free coverage; do not grow it to chase a number.
_workspace_caveat: packages/music-rules is DELIBERATELY absent. npm workspaces symlink it into node_modules, and Stryker's sandbox resolves that symlink back to the REAL file — so it mutates a copy nothing loads and reports 0%/all-no-coverage for code tests/music.test.ts genuinely covers. A knowingly false number teaches everyone to ignore the report, so the module is excluded until the resolution is fixed; its rules stay pinned by music.test.ts and the TS-vs-SQL mirror test. packages/site-bridge is absent for the SAME reason — its cursor/styles/frame rules stay pinned by the site-bridge-*.test.ts suites.
_thresholds_comment: break is a RATCHET, not a target: raise it as the score rises, never lower it to make a red build green. A drop means a new line went unwatched or an existing test stopped biting — that is the report doing its job. First honest baseline was 70.7% (2026-08-05); 72.59% on 2026-08-10 after link-vocabulary.ts and panel-inputs.ts joined the slice, so break moves to 70; the aggregate is dragged down by the DB-backed halves of song-merge.ts and storage-gc.ts, whose lines no DB-free test executes (Stryker counts those as no-coverage). 2026-09-03: artist-facts.ts and seo-audit.ts joined the slice (they were pure with DB-free tests and unwatched — the omission AGENTS.md names). A targeted run over just those two: artist-facts.ts 93.55%, seo-audit.ts 62.55%, and they add 282 of the slice's 5302 mutants, so the aggregate moves ~0.3pp — break stays 70, and seo-audit.ts's 68 survivors are the work, not the threshold. The per-file survivor list is the actionable output, not this number. high/low only colour the HTML report. 2026-09-11: event/derive.ts + _shared/{hash,request,cors}.ts joined (derive.ts 93% targeted); ratchet `break` after the next full sweep, not from memory.
